notes._comment: Editorial content. NOT auto-refreshed. Every block carries its own as_of and the app prints it, so stale commentary is visible rather than silently wrong. Bilingual: *_fr fields are the French copy.

quotes.head: “The toll road for tokenised finance”
quotes.head_fr: « Le péage de la finance tokenisée »
quotes.body: Larry Fink describes Ethereum as the toll road for tokenised finance, projecting that the $500 trillion of global financial assets will eventually be tokenised for 24/7 settlement. Most existing tokenised real-world assets already sit on Ethereum.
quotes.body_fr: Larry Fink qualifie Ethereum de péage de la finance tokenisée, et prévoit que les 500 000 milliards de dollars d'actifs financiers mondiaux finiront tokenisés pour un règlement 24h/24. L'essentiel des actifs réels déjà tokenisés se trouve sur Ethereum.

quotes.head: “A unique hybrid asset”
quotes.body: Sets out ether's hybrid case: network fuel, universal reserve collateral, and a natively yield-bearing asset through staking, at roughly 2.7% a year.
quotes.body_fr: Défend la thèse hybride de l'ether : carburant du réseau, collatéral de réserve universel, et actif à rendement natif via le staking, autour de 2,7 % par an.

quotes.head: “10x stablecoins, and AI agents”
quotes.body: Projects tenfold growth in stablecoins, and notes that autonomous AI agents will use blockchain rails natively because they have no legal identity and cannot hold bank accounts.
quotes.body_fr: Prévoit une multiplication par dix du marché des stablecoins, et souligne que les agents IA autonomes utiliseront nativement la blockchain : ils n'ont ni identité juridique ni compte bancaire.

adoption.caveat: Messari's August read found Ethereum's fundamentals close to flat: tokenised value +2.1%, stablecoin supply +0.2%, application revenue +1.6%, transactions −3.2%. Flows recovered; usage didn't.
adoption.caveat_fr: L'analyse Messari d'août trouvait des fondamentaux Ethereum quasi stables : valeur tokenisée +2,1 %, offre de stablecoins +0,2 %, revenus applicatifs +1,6 %, transactions −3,2 %. Les flux sont revenus ; l'usage non.

treasury_note.text: Accumulation was ferocious through August 2025, then essentially stopped. Whatever is driving the equity's rerating, it is not the company buying more ether.
treasury_note.text_fr: L'accumulation a été féroce jusqu'en août 2025, puis s'est essentiellement arrêtée. Quelle que soit la cause de la revalorisation de l'action, ce n'est pas la société qui achète davantage d'ether.

treasury_profile._comment: Company-specific claims about SharpLink's funding model. Editorial, from company filings and releases — no free API publishes capital structure. Re-verify when the company reports.
treasury_profile.debt: No debt disclosed. The treasury was built with equity issuance, not borrowing, so there is no maturity date on which cash must exist.
treasury_profile.debt_fr: Aucune dette déclarée. La trésorerie a été constituée par émission d'actions, pas par emprunt : il n'existe donc aucune échéance à laquelle du cash doit être disponible.
treasury_profile.opex: Operating costs are reported to sit below what the staked treasury earns, so the treasury funds the company rather than the company having to sell the treasury.
treasury_profile.opex_fr: Les frais d'exploitation sont annoncés comme inférieurs à ce que rapporte la trésorerie stakée : c'est la trésorerie qui finance la société, et non l'inverse.
treasury_profile.caveat: Both claims come from company disclosure, not from an independent feed, and a policy that holds today can change at the next board meeting. Treat them as the company's stated position, re-checked when it reports.
treasury_profile.caveat_fr: Ces deux affirmations proviennent des communications de la société, pas d'une source indépendante, et une politique valable aujourd'hui peut changer au prochain conseil d'administration. À considérer comme la position déclarée de la société, à revérifier à chaque publication.

forecasts._comment: Published third-party price targets, taken from the investment simulator. Editorial: these are other people's forecasts, not this site's, and long-range crypto forecasts have a poor record. Kept so the spread is visible rather than a single number.

long_run_returns._comment: Fixed historical anchors, used to show what each asset has actually returned per year over the long run beside the return a price target implies. No free API publishes a ten-year window, so the start prices are editorial and dated; the end of the window is live spot, so the figure refreshes on its own. Monthly closes, rounded, from the first of the month.

lgc._comment: The logarithmic growth curve chart shown beside the published forecasts. A still image, not a feed: it is replaced by hand when a newer one is published. Credit and the date printed on the chart are kept here so the page states both.
lgc.author: @davethewave

ownership._comment: Who owns the shares, and the short-interest figures as a published screener reports them. REPORTED VALUES WIN: set short_float_pct / short_shares / days_to_cover here and the page prints them verbatim. Leave short_float_pct null and the page falls back to dividing the FINRA settlement figure by float_shares, which keeps moving on its own but is only as good as the float. Holder positions are last-reported 13F; percentages are of shares outstanding.
ownership.source: 13F filings and the FINRA short-interest settlement
ownership.source_fr: Déclarations 13F et arrêté FINRA des positions vendeuses

treasuries._comment: The three treasury companies part five points at. strategy._comment: Part seven. HAND-MAINTAINED: the coin count, the claims ranking ahead of the common shares and the preferred terms come from company filings and disclosures, none of which has a free feed. STRC's price does refresh, from stockanalysis.com. Correct these from the filings.
strategy.senior_note: Convertible notes and preferred shares, which are repaid or redeemed before the ordinary shares receive anything.
strategy.senior_note_fr: Obligations convertibles et actions de préférence, remboursées ou rachetées avant que les actions ordinaires ne touchent quoi que ce soit.
strategy.strc_note: STRC is a perpetual preferred share with a stated value of $100 that pays a monthly dividend. The rate is adjusted with the intention of keeping it near that value, so $100 is the reference the price is read against rather than a target.
strategy.strc_note_fr: STRC est une action de préférence perpétuelle d'une valeur nominale de 100 $ qui verse un dividende mensuel. Le taux est ajusté dans l'intention de la maintenir proche de cette valeur : 100 $ est donc la référence à laquelle se lit le cours, pas un objectif.
strategy.drawdown_note: The company's own framing of what a forced sale would require: a fall of roughly this size that then stays down for years, rather than a fall on its own.
strategy.drawdown_note_fr: La formulation de la société elle-même sur ce qu'exigerait une vente forcée : une chute de cet ordre qui se prolonge ensuite pendant des années, et non une chute isolée.

assumptions._comment: Canonical thesis assumptions. Every page reads these, so the targets cannot drift between dashboards. Edit here, not in the pages.

cases._comment: The two 2030 cases. base is the conservative one and bull the optimistic one; both are upward, so neither is a downside scenario. The genuinely bad outcome is modelled on the allocation page, where the crypto position goes to zero. Note the implied ETH/BTC ratio (eth_usd / btc_usd) sits above the ten-year average shown in ethbtc_reference: the cases value each asset on its own terms, so the ratio they imply is an output, not an input.

simulator_cases._comment: Targets for the fifteen-year simulator on the allocation page. They sit above the 2030 cases because the horizon is longer: the 2030 cases stop at 2030, these run to horizon_year. Kept separate so neither set drags the other.

ethbtc_reference._comment: Historical ETH/BTC averages. Not auto-refreshed: the free CoinGecko window is 365 days, too short to compute a 10-year mean. The live ratio IS refreshed and shown beside these.

allocation_example._comment: A HYPOTHETICAL worked example, not anyone's portfolio. Defaults only; the page lets the reader change every number and keeps their edits in their own browser.
